text:
Elena: spotted a weird recurring pattern in na-west: p95 spikes correlate with dedicated-slice handoffs during high egress churn. Feels like were getting billed surprises and routing thrash.
Marcus: I saw logs too. When allocator tries warm-handoff and fails due to strict routing constraints, it retries and increases concurrent egress, causing NIC queue pileups.
Kai: Repro: tenant `voice-gen-ded` pushes big streaming batches; allocator attempted 3 handoffs in 90s because az-affinity blocked warm placement -> net thrash.
InfraBot: [alert] handoff-retry-thrash@na-west hosts=[rack3-05,rack7-02] duration=60s severity=medium auto_action=none reason=dedicated-affinity
Elena: Quick mitigation plan: 1) pause allocator retries for that tenant, 2) open an ephemeral "egress-insurance" cushion in same AZ and move tenant with preserve-kv and a clear billing tag, 3) apply soft egress-cap (tc) to stop queue spikes.
Marcus: Command run: `allocator move-tenant --tenant=voice-gen-ded --to=insurance-rack3 --preserve-kv --billing-tag emergency_insurance`
Marcus: Allocator: handoff accepted; warming KV on insurance-rack3. Applying egress policy `insurance-240mbit-burst` and tc tbf.
Kai: Applying tc: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 240mbit burst 64k latency 100ms` and cgroup limit for the tenant.
Elena: After move p95 dropped 420ms -> 90ms in ~70s. Nic queue drained. Good immediate fix.
BillingBot: Notice: emergency_insurance billing-tag set. Estimated delta so far: +0.48 GPU-hrs, est cost +$0.62. Event will be attached to tenant invoice.
Marcus: Follow-ups: we need 3 things: A) scheduler preflight that simulates handoff success probability before attempting (fail fast and suggest options), B) an "egress-insurance" primitive with automated billing annotation and owner notification, C) a backoff so allocator doesn't retry affinity handoffs more than once without human ack.
Kai: Also propose a lightweight console modal that warns tenant owners when infra is about to apply emergency insurance and shows estimated cost delta and duration. Opt-out per tenant.
Elena: I'll file INFRA-9009 to track preflight + insurance primitive + UI + backoff. Assign infra-scheduler + billing + console.
InfraBot: Ticket INFRA-9009 created (owner=infra-scheduler, priority=high).
Marcus: Root cause: tenant increased streaming concurrency in a deploy earlier today and removed client-side pacing. We'll advise them to add a soft rate limiter and reduce beam/concurrency.
Kai: For immediate guardrails: add alert rule: if allocator_handoff_retries_by_reason{affinity}>1 AND nic_tx_queue_len>150 -> auto-suggest insurance and pause further retries.
Elena: Keeping cushion active for 30m, will revert if stable and attach billing note to tenant. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Marcus: Nice triage. Let's also add a KB entry for tenants about "how infra insurance works" and examples of when we'll use it.
Kai: Will draft KB and attach to INFRA-9009.
